headline: Brewers' Aaron Ashby breaks postseason scoreless relief record as World Series Game 4 goes to extras
description: Milwaukee Brewers left-hander Aaron Ashby broke Andrew Miller’s record for scoreless innings by a reliever in one postseason with a 1-2-3 ninth in Game 4 of the World Series. Ashby followed with a scoreless 10th and hasn’t allowed a run in 17 2/3 innings in nine postseason appearances. Milwaukee was tied 2-2 with Tampa Bay going into the 11th inning. The Brewers led the series 3-0 and were a victory away from the first World Series title in franchise history. Ashby, who was 13-3 with a 3.12 ERA in 71 relief appearances during the season, has been untouchable in October. He’s allowed five hits, walked three and has 19 strikeouts.
author: ROB MAADDI
